ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Neptune

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between family and your image. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
With Mercury retrograde in your money sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between money and friendships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your image and your career. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
With Mercury retrograde in your inner life sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
With Mercury retrograde in your career sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your career and relationships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
With Mercury retrograde in your intimacy sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon lights up love, children and the inner child we all have. Laugh more and worry less.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Hear both sides before you decide.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Laugh at yourself when something goes less well.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon asks you for a safe harbour. If the day is hectic outside, create calm in your own space.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between relationships and family. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
With Mercury retrograde in your daily routine sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Make peace with a childhood memory.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between routine and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Apologise for a careless word, if need be.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.
The square between the Sun and Neptune creates some tension between romance and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
With Mercury retrograde in your home and family sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Put aside a small amount, just to build the habit.
